com.esignal.jstandard.beans.quote

Enum QUOTEFIELDS

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.lang.Enum<QUOTEFIELDS>
      • com.esignal.jstandard.beans.quote.QUOTEFIELDS
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Comparable<QUOTEFIELDS>
    Deprecated.

    @Deprecated
public enum QUOTEFIELDS
extends java.lang.Enum<QUOTEFIELDS>
    This enum defines all the possible fields that can be added as part of the Quote object. Each field has a type() method which defines the type of class the object could be in. Also, it has a convert method which can convert values from String to appropriate Object type. This ensure that the value to be stored is in proper format.
    Since:
    01-001-0007
    Author:
    Interactive Data Corporation

      • BASE_QUOTE_FIELD

        public static final QUOTEFIELDS BASE_QUOTE_FIELD
        Deprecated. 
        Refer to the documentation for type of conversion based on the character. Calculation for 'H' -> .75 (6/8), .50 (4/8), .25 (2/8) Thus a future value of 376.5 will become 376'4 or 3764 or however the client wants to represent. Here's a full list of conversions: 
         Base Code      Multiplier
 A or a         10000
 B or b         1000
 C or c         100
 D or d         10
 E or e         1
 F or f         1/2
 G or g         1/4
 H or h         1/8
 I or i         1/10
 J or j         1/16
 K or k         1/32
 L or l         1/64
 M or m         1/100
 N or n         1/1000
 O or o         1/10000
 P or p         1/100000
 Q or q         1/128
 R or r         1/256
 S                      1/32 and tenths of 32
 T                      1/10 and quarters of 10
 U                      1/32 and quarters of 32
 V                      1/64 and tenths of 64
 W or w         1/1000000
 X or x         1/10000000
 Y or y         1/100000000
 Z or z         1/1000000000
        For more information contact the support. This is a Character type object.
        See Also:
        type()
